items.title: Vanishing of the higher etale cohomology of the pushforward of the multiplicative group from the generic point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts the vanishing of the etale cohomology of j_* of the multiplicative group of the generic point in all positive degrees (statement lines 11034-11037). The proof is a complete spectral sequence argument: the Leray spectral sequence is displayed with its E_2 page and abutment (proof lines 11040-11044); the abutment vanishes in positive total degree by the companion vanishing for the function field (proof lines 11045-11046); the terms with q at least one vanish by the companion result on higher direct images (proof lines 11047-11048); and the desired vanishing follows (proof lines 11048-11049). The non-formal content is the bookkeeping that only these two vanishing statements are needed. The claim is H2: a displayed spectral sequence with both vanishing inputs named.
